text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"Alright, feeling in top shape! Today for 
sure, I'm gonna give it my all! 
Hokko... Lucky☆"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"No, that's just a straight-up ripoff! 
But, gotta stay upbeat. Go with the 
flow... yeah, just ride the vibe!"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I can't afford to be so rigid all the 
time...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"Bringing you the charm of dirt racing 
with a flash! I'm Copano Rickey! 
It's finally here! The Midsummer Beach 
Dirt Festival♪"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: "Wooo! I'm super pumped up!"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"Oops, forgot to introduce myself! 
I'm the migratory bird on paper wings, 
surf clam-loving Hokko Tarumae☆"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"Um, this ocean is just as gorgeous as the 
sea back in Tomakomai! 
So then, is everybody ready to go!? Nobody 
left behind, right~!?"

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"...? 'Fighting spirit even in the heat!' 
Wonder Acute here~. 
Now then, the opening ceremony is just 
about to star..."

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"Eeeek! Shall we, count down right now~~!? 
Alright! Everyone in the crowd, follow my 
lead~! Loud and proud~~!!"

text_block_list.name: Event Staff
text_block_list.text:
"E-Excuse me! Aren't you rushing things 
just a bit~? 
Since we're outdoors, if you speak too 
fast, people won't be able to hear you..."

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: I-I'm so sorry!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"Tarumae... Are you still not feeling 
well? 
You don't have to push yourself so hard, 
just act like you usually—"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"I-I'm not pushing myself...! I'm fine, 
really... 
I'll do it right next time."

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"Sorry... for killing the vibe. 
But I'll make sure to do it just like 
Rickey...!"

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Huh, you don't have to—

text_block_list.name: Event Staff
text_block_list.text:
Alright, from the top one more time. 
Ready, action!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Mmmgh, that's... that is definitely...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"Tarumae-san is clearly panicking, isn't 
she? 
Is she trying to match Rickey-san's 
energetic pace?"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
If even Flash-san noticed, it must be 
pretty bad...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"Wha—what is that supposed to mean? 
After spending this much time with you, 
even I can tell that much."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Besides... it does feel somewhat familiar 
to me.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"...Um, Falcon-san. 
Forgive me for asking out of the blue, but 
when was the last time the windows were 
cleaned?"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"The windows? When was that again~? 
During the big year-end cleaning, 
maybe...?"

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"(...!? Left alone for that long? No 
wonder there's so much dust. 
Back home, I would wipe them down at least 
once a week, but...)"

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"'Big year-end cleaning'... Alles klar! 
If that is the rule of this room, then I 
shall adapt...!"

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"............... Ha! 
O nein... focus, focus..."

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Hm? Something out there...? 
Ah, wait... is the dirt bugging you?"

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: N-Not at all...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Uh-uh, you have to tell me these things! 
It's a room for both of us, after all☆"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Ah~ I remember that! Good times! 
You held back so much at the beginning, 
Flash-san~."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"It was simply difficult to speak up. 
Back then, I believed I should be the one 
to adapt to everything."

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"We're in a great groove now, right? 
Whenever something comes up, we talk it 
through properly."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"Yes, I believe we respect each other 
well. 
When living together, differences in 
perspective are bound to arise."

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Totally~ Falco doesn't even know how many 
'once-in-a-lifetime favors' she's used up 
by now☆

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"I would prefer if you kept track of that, 
but... 
For now, let us return to discussing those 
three."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"If only they had some sort of catalyst, I 
believe. 
Then things could go much smoother..."

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Wouldn't that be... you know, that thing? 
The one that helped us get along. In times 
like this~."

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text:
"'Teamwork exercises'! 
'Teamwork exercises'... you say?"

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"...And so, we'd like you all to go to the 
'Great Blue Hole' and shoot some photos 
and videos for UmaTok."

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"Uh-huh, got it☆ 
Insta-worthy shots to post on the 
festival's official social media, right~? 
But wait, is it okay to use a sightseeing 
spot outside the venue?"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"Just the three of us? 
What about the camera crew...?"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"It's for the tourists going around to all 
the spots☆ 
Plus, it adds that live, authentic feel! 
Like, 'Look at us all enjoying sightseeing 
together~!'"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"I see. So more like candid off-shots, 
taking a different approach from the 
rigid, formal footage we've done so far."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"Precisely. There are no strict 
specifications, 
so please just give us what you all feel 
is your 'best take.'"

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: "Right! We're on our way!"

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"Oh my, quite sudden, isn't it? 
You two, could it be...?"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: *whistle~ trill trill trill~♪*

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"Fufu, an opportunity like this should 
give us time for a nice, long chat. 
Thank you for your thoughtfulness."

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"There's something I want to tell her too. 
Even if it's little by little, I'm not 
giving up—I'll talk to her again."

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Well then, we'll be on our way~♪

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"I hope... it goes well. 
toi, toi, toi...――"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: It'll be alright. I'm sure it will be.
